note: Where the design's links go in the site. Applied by scripts/html-to-jsx.mjs when it generates a page (hrefs are not measured by the gate). "*.dc.html" links are mapped to the routes of spec/pages.json first; then these rules apply to links whose visible text matches exactly (and page, if given). A value in braces is an expression: {KEY} becomes href={links.KEY}, imported from lib/links.ts, which the site defines (CAL_URL, START_FREE, REPO_URL).
